heuristics_and_laws.implementation: Standard event card layout with image, title, date, venue, and familiar status badges; calendar follows Monday-first grid and agenda feed conventions
Large, easily clickable primary actions (Manage event / Resume draft) and prominent full-width action buttons on mobile
Clean period tabs (All / Upcoming / Past) reduce cognitive load when filtering large event rosters
Explicit provenance badges (Published, Draft, Local draft, Sync failed, Shared by X) truthfully convey server and sync status
Sync failed events preserve local payloads without data loss; delete modal requires explicit confirmation before removing backend data
Contextual 'Continue where you left off' resume draft banner surfaces pending work immediately upon opening /app/events
